messages:
marta (pm): Deploybot just raised an auto-rollback for eu-west canary due to an error-rate spike. Were in a change window for 30m; need quick ops decision on manual hold vs letting rollback run.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: Canary alert for release rc5_eu â€” error_rate 5.2% (threshold 1%). Auto-rollback in 3m unless human abort. job=90102.

dev (eng): I see a surge of 429s pointing at upstream auth. Not confident it's our model code. Can someone hold the auto-rollback while I check?

kai (sre): We can hold but note policy: no destructive rollback during change window without ops lead. I'll take the manual-override if needed.

marta (pm): @kai please request override. If we hold, pin previous stable v3.5.0 for routing to avoid churn.

ops-bot: Opsbot: Manual-override request created: INF-6423. Requires oncall or SRE lead approval.

kai (sre): Oncall (me) approves manual hold. Running: `deployctl hold --release rc5_eu` 13 done.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: Hold accepted for rc5_eu. Auto-rollback canceled, monitoring window extended +20m.

dev (eng): Thanks. I'll prepare a rollback-candidate branch but won't merge unless required. Initial guess: auth cache TTL misconfig -> 429 storm. Patch incoming.

nina (support): FYI support: two premium customers reported intermittent failures; they asked if this was related to the rollout. Do we want a proactive line now?

marta (pm): Yes, short note: "Investigating brief canary errors during EU rollout; no impact to pinned production traffic. We'll follow up in 30m." Nina pls send.

nina (support): Sent to #support and created incident summary INF-6423.

kai (sre): Pinning old version on edge: `edgectl pin --service inference-api --version v3.5.0 --region eu-west` 13 completed and annotated INF-6423.

dev (eng): PR open: fix/auth-ttl -> https://git/repo/pulls/456. Running CI now.

kai (sre): If CI fails or error_rate doesn't drop in 20m we proceed with manual rollback: `deployctl revert --to v3.5.0 --region eu-west` and open a rollback postmortem ticket.

marta (pm): Action items logged in INF-6423: 1) hold (done) 2) pin v3.5.0 (done) 3) support note (done) 4) merge fix if green 5) staged resume at low %.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: Monitoring set: error_rate, 429_rate, p95_latency. If error_rate > 1% for 15 continuous minutes, auto-rollback will be re-armed.

dev (eng): CI is green. Requesting ops signoff to merge and resume rollout gradually.

kai (sre): Ops signoff: ✅ Merge and resume at 5% traffic; if stable after 5m, bump to 20%. I'll be watching dashboards.

marta (pm): Kai will trigger resume. Keep thread open until we reach 100% or we revert.

dev (eng): Merging now.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: Release rc5_eu resumed at 5% traffic. Watch metrics closely.

nina (support): Notified affected customers: "Patch merged and rolling resume begun; monitoring closely."

kai (sre): After 25m of monitoring metrics are green (error_rate < 0.5%, p95 stable). I'll plan to lift the pin in 10m unless we see regressions.

marta (pm): Thanks team. Closing thread after pin removal and a short follow-up doc about change-window rollback rules.

dev (eng): noted. I'll add a short blurb in the release notes about the hotfix and that the rollback was human-held.

kai (sre): Pin removed: `edgectl unpin --service inference-api --region eu-west` 13 done. Marking INF-6423 resolved.

marta (pm): Thread closed. Postmortem not required since human hold prevented a noisy auto-rollback, but we'll add a short incident note in the deployment runbook.
